title: A Robust Measure on FDFAs Following Duo-Normalized Acceptance
reasoning: The paper is a theoretical computer science paper focused on automata theory, specifically Families of DFAs (FDFAs) and w-regular languages. It introduces a new acceptance condition and a complexity measure (diameter measure) for FDFAs, and analyzes its properties and correlation to the Wagner hierarchy. There are no components in the paper that evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
